00-aujourdhui: Today, we're learning the letter g.
02-regarde: Watch how we write the g.
03-depart: We start on the green dot. We make a round: we turn to the LEFT, we go round the bottom, and we come back to the green dot. We lift the pencil. We start again a little higher and we come straight DOWN, below the line. Then we make a big loop to the LEFT, which comes back up and rests on the line.
04-encore: One more time, a little faster.
05-cherchons: Now, let's find words that begin with the hard g sound.
10-pareil: Did you hear? They all begin the same way.
11-relance: Find a word that begins with g.
